products.product_description: Pascalite Capsules 100 count white plastic bottle with a screw on top, Pascalite Inc, PO Box 104 Worland, WY 82401 307-347-3872, Dietary Supplement for adults and children over 12 years two capsules daily, each vegi cap (size 00) contains approx. 1/4 tsp pascalite powder.
